name: sudo
purpose: Executes a single command with elevated superuser (`root`) administrative privileges.
explanation: Temporarily grants `root` privileges for one command after verifying your password, required for system-wide package installation (`apt`) or protected OS files.
expectedOutput:
[sudo] password for student:
Reading package lists... Done
whenToUse: Only when an administrative operation (like `apt install` or reading `/var/log/auth.log`) requires `root` permission.
commonMistakes: Using `sudo` reflexively on user-owned files or `pip`/`git` commands, which can leave root-owned files in your home folder.
explanationOfOutput: Prompts for password (characters are hidden as you type!) then runs the command as UID 0 (`root`).
commonErrors: `student is not in the sudoers file`
